entry.title: Social Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: Bot Screen / Desktop Passthrough Launch (dominant story): @NousResearch unveiled Bot Screen in Hermes Desktop, live-streaming any bot session — browser driving, terminal typing, window use — to massive engagement (1958 likes, 394k views). Founder @Teknium followed with the interactive companion announcement: users can now visually and interactively access the same machine as their Hermes Agent via remote gateways (1141 likes, 173k views). Official documentation and a @tonbistudio walkthrough video (540 likes) round out the launch, and community hype ran hot — 'Finally!', 'Much needed!', 'Impressive!'. Community OSS / oh-my-hermes Ecosystem: Prioritized community author @rlaope had a prolific stretch, open-sourcing jeval (JEV evaluation with visual result extraction) and shipping a major oh-my-hermes (OMH) update adding Jev-Skils, model aliases, and routing across skills/models/agents/memory/MCP — signaling a fast-maturing community plugin layer around hermes-agent. Guides & Usage Tips: @Teknium amplified @tonbistudio's guide video, and @NousResearch shared a practical tip: run Hermes via iMessage with whichever model you prefer. Maintainer Engagement & Sentiment: The overall mood is excitement plus confidence in responsiveness — @Teknium pushed back on an unverified cache-bug claim with clear repro-issue guidance, clarified a misattributed project as built by NousResearch rather than Anthropic, and confirmed a same-day fix after user feedback. Sentiment skews strongly positive, with @rlaope also musing that Opus 5.5 is impressive but voicing hesitation on Claude Code — implicitly positioning Hermes Agent as the community alternative.
